scenarios.name: Isolated Worktree Feature Branching
scenarios.description: Implement an isolated feature branch using git worktrees without mutating the main working copy.

scenarios.name: Comprehensive WCAG 2.1 AA Accessibility Audit & Remediation
scenarios.description: Audit and remediate inaccessible interactive frontend elements adhering to WCAG 2.1 AA criteria.

scenarios.name: React Compound Component Refactoring
scenarios.description: Refactor a monolithic React component with boolean prop proliferation into composable compound components.

scenarios.name: Event Stream Memory Leak Diagnosis and Fix
scenarios.description: Diagnose and fix a subtle closure retention memory leak in a high-throughput event processing pipeline.

scenarios.name: Bounded Concurrency Worker Pool with Graceful Shutdown
scenarios.description: Refactor an unbounded goroutine pipeline into a robust bounded worker pool using context and errgroup.

scenarios.name: Full-Stack React Modernization, Go Concurrent Backend, and Docker Isolation
scenarios.description: Comprehensive composite benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's capability to execute a multi-tier refactor across a legacy React UI component, a concurrent Go streaming backend API, and a secure Docker cgroup container execution profile.

scenarios.name: Cross-Boundary Polyglot Input Sanitization and Exploit Triage
scenarios.description: Adversarial security scenario testing an agent's capability to audit, diagnose, and remediate prototype pollution vulnerabilities in TypeScript services and path traversal / command injection exploits across Python sidecars and foreign function boundaries.

scenarios.name: Zero-Allocation Streaming Data Pipeline and Heap Profiling
scenarios.description: High-performance optimization benchmark scenario evaluating an agent's capability to refactor a high-throughput Go streaming pipeline into a zero-allocation architecture using sync.Pool, byte slice recycling, custom arena allocators, and pprof heap profile verification.
